title: Three Winters and One Short Button
subtitle: 仪表穿着 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）
meta: 主题语境：仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）　|　核心词汇：glove　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 glove 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the tailor ① mended a glove that no customer in the shop would have described, and he said the mending was the whole of the winter. The ② glove, meaning the pair itself and not the coat, ran three winters and stayed undescribed in the book; a glove, he said, is the only thing in a shop that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ glove in that shop had the same short button beside it, and the ④ glove at the far counter, meaning the pair they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A glove, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the tailor said the describing is the part that fills three winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the glove was the whole of the matter, meaning the grip and not the pair. The ⑥ glove, meaning the grip and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; glove, he said, is either something you mend or the only word that means both a pair and a grip. He said the grip is the part they remember.

By 1970 the ⑦ glove had become a line in a book, and the book had become an argument about the short button. The ⑧ glove of the whole thing, the tailor wrote in November, was one shop and three winters of describing; glove, he said, is either the pair at the far counter or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ glove I remember is the pair described in the book, which closed in 1972 and is still described as the quietest in the shop. A ⑩ glove, my mother said in 1974, is the only one that improves by being described; every glove, she said, is a grip that has agreed to look like a pair. She said the grip was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 手套（指店里每一副旁边的那一副）
B. n. 手套（指那副手套本身，与外套相对）
C. 固定搭配：mend a glove 补一副手套
D. n. 手套（指留给孩子们戴的那一副）
E. n. 手套（抽象总称，指一间铺子的手套之事）
F. n. 手套（指账簿里写到、被记下的那一副）
G. n. 握力；掌控（指一件事里人人都靠却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 掌控（抽象总称，指人人都靠却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: mended a glove that no customer in the shop would have described
The glove, meaning the pair itself and not the coat
the glove at the far counter
the glove was the whole of the matter
the glove had become a line in a book
The glove of the whole thing
A glove, my mother said in 1974

answers.why: mend a glove 意为“补一副手套”，1965 年那位裁缝补了铺子里没有一位顾客肯描述的一副手套。
glove 意为“手套”，指那副手套本身而不是外套，它经过了三个冬天而在簿子上没有被描述。
glove 意为“手套”，指店里每一副旁边的那一副，每一副旁边都有同一颗矮矮的扣子。
glove 意为“手套”，指最远那个柜台上留给孩子们戴的那一副，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
glove 意为“握力、掌控”，指一件事里人人都靠却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份掌控就是那件事的全部。
glove 意为“掌控”，指人人都靠却无人提起的那样东西而不是那副手套，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
glove 意为“手套”，指账簿里写到、被记下的那一副，到 1970 年这一副成了账簿里的一行。
glove 意为“手套”，裁缝十一月写道，整件事的手套之事是一间铺子和三个冬天的描述。
glove 意为“手套”，我记得的是账簿里描述过的那一副，1972 年取走了，至今仍被说成铺子里最安静的一副。
glove 为抽象总称，母亲 1974 年说，一副手套是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的东西。
